summary: Sort gaps and timeline searches by datetime instead of cloud cover.
reason: gaps and timeline sample temporal coverage, but both built the search with sortCloudAsc=true. Under the pagination cap, a date whose only acquisition is high-cloud gets pushed off the result window, producing a false gap (gaps) or a dropped date (timeline). Now pass sortCloudAsc=false and set an explicit properties.datetime desc sort so pagination samples across time. scenes best keeps the cloud sort intentionally (it wants the clearest scene).
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; verify-skill matches shipped CLI source.
